full_text_zh:
[P1] 雪狮头
连环画出版社

[P2] 胡永凯（1945— ）擅长装饰画、连环画。
1964年毕业于中央美术学院附中，历任上海美术电影制片厂美术设计、上海大学美术学院教师。作品
《消夏》获第六届全国美展优秀作品奖，《荷韵》
获第九届全国优秀作品奖。

[P3] 雪狮子
鲁兵/诗 胡永凯/画
连环画出版社

[P4] 小朋友，小朋友，
雪地里，滚雪球。
雪球堆个大狮子，
狮子，狮子，开大口。
少条尾巴怎么办，
有了，插上一把破扫帚。

[P5] 半夜里，静悄悄，
雪狮子，伸伸腰，
一蹦一跳站起来，
摇头摆尾大声叫：
“我是狮子，
我是大王。
我的肚子饿了，
谁来填填我的肚肠！”

[P6] 它看见小狗就咬小狗，
它看见小猫就咬小猫，
吓得小狗汪汪叫：
“狮子来了，快跑，快跑！
吓得小猫喵喵叫：
“狮子来了，快逃，快逃！”，

[P7] 有位老爷爷，
听见狗叫猫叫，
走出门来瞧一瞧，
笑得胡子一翘一翘：
“小猫，小狗，
别跑，别走！
哪有狮子屁股上
长了一把破扫帚？”

[P8] 雪狮子
来到老爷爷家门口，
雪狮子
朝着老爷爷一声吼：
“小狗小猫不够吃，
再吃一个小老头儿。”

[P9] 小狗打哆嗦，
小猫往后躲，
老爷爷呢？
慢腾腾地把话说：
“狮子，狮子，累了吧？
请你坐一坐。
狮子，狮子，冷了吧？
请你烤烤火。
等会儿再吃小猫和小狗，
吃了小猫小狗再吃我。”

雪狮子说：
“也好，也好，
小猫小狗火里烤，
你小老头儿也跑不了。”

老爷爷说：
“真好，真好！
你先坐着烤烤火，
马上就能尝到好味道。”

[P10] 小狗搬柴，
小猫搬草，
老爷爷一划自来火，
柴草呼呼呼地烧。
雪狮子说：
“不得了，不得了！
我的汗水像雨浇。”
老爷爷说：
“你伤风，你感冒，
出点汗水就会好。”

[P13] 雪狮子说：
“受不了，受不了！
我的身体在变小。”
老爷爷说：
“快加柴，快加草！
管你受不受得了。”

[P14] 后来呢？
鸡叫了，天明了，
小朋友们
打个滚儿起来了。

[P15] 真古怪，
真稀奇，
雪狮子，
在哪里？
只有一把破扫帚，
留在这儿雪地里。

[P16] 小朋友们
找来找去找不到，
小朋友们
猜来猜去猜不着。

[P17] 找不到，
猜不着，
快去问问老爷爷，
要不，去问问小狗小猫。

[P20] 毛毛虫童书馆·第一辑
《小蝌蚪找妈妈》
《东郭先生》
《老虎外婆》
《金瓜儿银豆儿》
《好乖乖》
《九色鹿》
《香蕉娃娃》
毛毛虫童书馆·第二辑
《胖嫂回娘家》
《三十六个字》
《嫦娥奔月》
《三借芭蕉扇》
《动物园》
《春节的故事》
毛毛虫童书馆·第三辑
《两只老鼠胆子大》
《聪明的乌龟》
《小山羊和小老虎》
《小猪奴尼》
▶《雪狮子》
full_text_en:
[P1] Snow Lion Head
Lianhuanhua Publishing House

[P2] Hu Yongkai (1945— ) is skilled in decorative painting and illustrated stories.
Graduated from the Central Academy of Fine Arts Affiliated Middle School in 1964, he served as art designer at Shanghai Animation Film Studio and as a teacher at the Shanghai University Academy of Fine Arts. His works
"Xiaxia" won the Excellent Work Award at the Sixth National Art Exhibition, and "He Yun"
won the Excellent Work Award at the Ninth National Exhibition.

[P3] Snow Lion
Lu Bing / Poem  Hu Yongkai / Illustrations
Lianhuanhua Publishing House

[P4] Children, children,
In the snowy ground, roll snowballs.
Stack snowballs into a big lion,
Lion, lion, open your big mouth.
What to do if it's missing a tail?
Got it, stick on an old broom.

[P5] In the middle of the night, quiet and still,
the snow lion stretches its back,
jumps up with a bounce,
shakes its head and tail, and roars loudly:
"I am the lion,
I am the king.
My stomach is hungry,
who will fill my belly!"

[P6] It bites the puppy when it sees the puppy,
It bites the kitten when it sees the kitten,
The puppy barks in fear:
"The lion is coming, run, run!"
The kitten meows in fear:
"The lion is coming, escape, escape!"

[P7] There was an old grandfather,
He heard the dog barking and the cat meowing,
He stepped out to take a look,
And laughed with his beard twitching:
"Little cat, little dog,
Don't run, don't go!
How could a lion have a broken broom growing from its rear?"

[P8] Snow Lion
Came to the old man's doorstep,
Snow Lion
Roared at the old man:
"Puppies and kittens aren't enough to eat,
I'll eat a little old man too."

[P9] The little dog trembles,
The little cat hides behind,
Where is Grandpa?
Slowly, he says:
"Lion, lion, are you tired?
Please sit down.
Lion, lion, are you cold?
Please warm yourself by the fire.
I'll eat the little cat and dog later,
After eating the cat and dog, I'll eat you."

The snow lion says:
"Alright, alright,
Roast the little cat and dog in the fire,
You little old man can't run away either."

Grandpa says:
"Wonderful, wonderful!
Sit and warm yourself by the fire first,
You'll taste the delicious flavor right away."

[P10] The puppy carries firewood,
The kitten carries grass,
The old man strikes a match,
The firewood and grass burn with a whoosh.
The snow lion says:
"Oh no, oh no!
My sweat is pouring like rain."
The old man says:
"You've caught a cold, you're feeling ill,
Sweating a bit will make you feel better."

[P13] The snow lion said:
"I can't stand it, I can't stand it!
My body is getting smaller."
The old man said:
"Quick, add more firewood, quick, add more grass!
I don't care if you can stand it or not."

[P14] What happened next?
Cocks crowed, the sky brightened,
the children
rolled over and got up.

[P15] Strange, strange,
Really odd,
Where is the snow lion?
Only an old broom,
Left here in the snowy ground.

[P16] Children
Looking everywhere, they can't find it,
Children
Guessing and guessing, they can't figure it out.

[P17] Can't find it,
Can't guess,
Quick, go ask Grandpa,
Or go ask the little dog and cat.

[P20] Caterpillar Children's Library · Volume 1
《Little Tadpole Looks for Mommy》
《Mr. Dongguo》
《Tiger Grandma》
《Golden Gourd, Silver Bean》
《Good Boy》
《Nine-Colored Deer》
《Banana Doll》
Caterpillar Children's Library · Volume 2
《Fat Sister Returns to Her Parents' Home》
《Thirty-Six Characters》
《Chang'e Flies to the Moon》
《Borrowing the Banana Fan Three Times》
《Zoo》
《The Story of Spring Festival》
Caterpillar Children's Library · Volume 3
《Two Mice with Big Courage》
《The Clever Turtle》
《Little Goat and Little Tiger》
《Little Pig Nuni》
▶《Snow Lion》
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《雪狮头》，画面中一位老人手持火把，身旁有小猫和一个带有雪花图案的狮头，背景为红色，下方标注出版社为连环画出版社。
[P2] 本页展示了作者胡永凯的黑白肖像照及其生平简介，介绍了他的艺术专长、教育背景、职业经历及主要获奖作品。
[P3] 本页为绘本《雪狮子》的扉页，显示了书名、作者鲁兵（诗）和绘者胡永凯（画），并配有蓝色雪狮子的插图，下方标注出版社为连环画出版社。
[P4] 本页描绘了孩子们在雪地里堆雪狮子的场景，他们用雪球堆出狮子的身体，并用一把破扫帚当作尾巴，画面充满童趣和想象力。
[P5] 半夜里，雪狮子从雪地里站起来，伸腰、蹦跳、摇头摆尾，大声宣告自己是狮子大王，并喊着肚子饿了，要有人来填饱它。
[P6] 雪狮子出现后，吓跑了小狗和小猫，小狗汪汪叫着让同伴快跑，小猫喵喵叫着让同伴快逃。
[P7] 一位老爷爷听到小狗和小猫惊叫后出门查看，笑着指出雪狮子尾巴是破扫帚，认为它不可能是真正的狮子。
[P8] 雪狮子来到老爷爷家门口，对着老爷爷吼叫，声称小狗小猫不够吃，还要吃掉一个小老头儿，画面中老爷爷和两只猫显得惊恐。
[P9] 雪狮子来到老爷爷家门口，老爷爷假装邀请它烤火，雪狮子同意后，老爷爷说它马上就能尝到好味道，暗示将用火对付它。
[P10] 本页描绘了小狗和小猫为雪狮子搬柴草，老爷爷划火点燃后，雪狮子因怕热而大叫，老爷爷则笑着安慰它出汗会好的场景。
[P11] 本页画面中，雪狮子因靠近火堆而害怕地大叫，身体冒出热气和汗珠，老爷爷在一旁笑着，似乎在安慰它，背景为红色，火焰熊熊燃烧，暗示雪狮子正在被火烤化。
[P12] 本页画面中，雪狮子在熊熊火焰前因受热而融化，身体冒出热气和汗珠，表情痛苦，背景为红色，火焰熊熊燃烧，暗示其正在被火烤化。
[P13] 雪狮子因靠近火堆而感到难受，身体开始变小，老爷爷则命令小狗和小猫继续加柴加草，毫不理会雪狮子的痛苦。
[P14] 天亮了，鸡叫了，小朋友们从床上醒来，打着滚儿起床，画面中一个孩子在床上伸懒腰，窗外有绿色的小动物探头张望。
[P15] 画面中，一只色彩鲜艳的老虎和一只鸟在红色背景中，下方文字描述雪狮子消失，只留下一把破扫帚在雪地里，暗示雪狮子已被烤化。
[P16] 小朋友们在红色背景下寻找某物，但找不到也猜不着，地上有一把破扫帚，暗示雪狮子已消失。
[P17] 小朋友们找不到雪狮子，猜不着它的下落，于是决定去问老爷爷或小狗小猫。
[P18] 画面中四个孩子在紫色背景下玩雪，分别戴着兔子、老虎等动物头饰，正在滚雪球，准备堆雪狮子，地面上有雪的痕迹。
[P19] 画面中四个孩子在紫色背景下玩雪，分别戴着兔子、老虎等动物头饰，正在滚雪球，准备堆雪狮子，地面上有雪的痕迹。
[P20] 本页展示了“毛毛虫童书馆”系列的三辑书目，其中第三辑包含《雪狮子》。下方插图描绘了一个带有虎纹把手的茶壶在炉火上烧水，蒸汽升腾，背景为绿色。
